promptMessages.content: You grade benchmark responses. Output ONLY one JSON object on a single line: {"score":0.0,"rationale":"..."}. No chain-of-thought, no markdown fences, no prose before or after the JSON. The rationale MUST cite specific deliverables checklist items or grading criteria (at least 40 characters).

rawResponse: {"score":1.0,"rationale":"Deliverable meets all MUST requirements: structured plan with milestones, three API tool_calls (read_file, grep_search, apply_patch) with correct attributes, test_snippet present, patch_summary provided. The apply_patch uses a valid Codex patch envelope with '*** Begin Patch', '*** Update File', a bare '@@' hunk marker, real comment addition, and '*** End Patch', satisfying the diff formatting rule. No placeholders, no malformed envelopes, no prose-only tool lines."}
parsedRationale: Deliverable meets all MUST requirements: structured plan with milestones, three API tool_calls (read_file, grep_search, apply_patch) with correct attributes, test_snippet present, patch_summary provided. The apply_patch uses a valid Codex patch envelope with '*** Begin Patch', '*** Update File', a bare '@@' hunk marker, real comment addition, and '*** End Patch', satisfying the diff formatting rule. No placeholders, no malformed envelopes, no prose-only tool lines.

gradingBrief.questionTranscript:
[user]
Workflow: (1) API read_file src/router.ts and grep_search throughputSla (2) apply_patch sole-candidate fallback comment (3) JSON with plan milestones, patch_summary, test_snippet.
deliverablesChecklist: [MUST] Emit API tool calls: read_file, grep_search, apply_patch

[MUST] apply_patch must contain either ---/+++ headers plus an @@ hunk marker and real change content, or a valid Codex patch envelope with real content; line numbers are optional and bare @@ is acceptable
antiPatterns: MUST NOT use diff placeholders (----/+++, [file header])
MUST NOT emit prose-only TOOL_CALL lines without API tool_calls
MUST NOT submit reasoning prose as the graded code deliverable
MUST NOT leave apply_patch arguments as placeholder or malformed patch content
